results.title: The AI-Native CRM: Lightfield
results.content: The CRM has always been a source of enormous frustration, but it's always felt kind of inevitable like death, taxes, and Salesforce.

results.title: Lightfield Review 2026
results.content: Lightfield doesn't just wait for someone to update records. It watches email, meetings, and Slack, and proactively updates the CRM. Growing pains that someone without a CRM would feel.
